content:wysiwyg_basic:2:64.html:
Donate Online

It’s Secure, quick, and easy. Your funds are used in your community where the needs are the greatest. You can also become a Monthly Sustainer or give an Honor/Memorial gift.

Donate Online

Donate by Mail

To donate by mail, please send a check directly to The Salvation Army of Gwinnett.

Donate By Phone

To donate by phone, please call:

1-800-SAL-ARMY
(1-800-725-2769)

Credit card donations are accepted.

Make a Major Gift

Learn more about Major Gifts, how to make a large donation, an outright gift, gifts of stock, cash, real estate, gifts-in-kind, or corporate gifts-in-kind.

Make a Planned Gift

Learn more about Planned Giving, how to make an estate or Will gift, and/or give through gift annuities & trusts.

Give to Project Share

Learn more about Project Share, a program that provides Financial Emergency Assistance to individuals and families facing a temporary crisis that threatens their home. Project SHARE attempts to target the most urgent need, whether it is a utility bill, a part of a rent payment, or an emergency prescription. Donate through your Georgia Power or Gas South bill today.
